description: Checks a phone number: valid or not, its formats and country, then by level its line type, the carrier it is on today, whether it is live on the network, or a fraud score. The levels are a ladder, each including the ones before it and priced on its own: basic, line_type (the default), current_carrier, line_status, fraud_score; what is not offered for the number comes back as unavailable, at no cost. Charged per check from your balance; the sandbox (a pt_test_ key) is free.

country.description: The two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. GB) of a number given in national format.

level.description: How far to look; line_type when omitted.

phone.description: The phone number, in international format (E.164, e.g. +447700900123), or in national format with the country.

name: look_up_phone_number
title: Look up a phone number
